config.cache: prompt_cache_options.mode explicit, breakpoint on the static developer block (30 min)

method.latency: performance.now() from just before each request to the parsed response (non-streaming); a tools sample sums every request plus local tool time
method.connections: Node fetch (undici) keep-alive; new connections counted from the undici:client:connected diagnostics channel. Samples where any request opened a connection are 'cold' and left out of the latency stats
method.warmup: one unscored request (line 01, perfect text) per runner and input before the samples, to open the connection, compile any schema grammar and write the prompt cache
method.order: for each repeat, every selected line in script order; requests one at a time
method.scoring: interp/score.ts: exact match after folding hold-shorts that follow a taxi into it; per-field over lines where either side has the field
method.shape: interp/shape.ts: exact keys and formats per src/sim/commands.ts, plus a terse round trip through parseTerse
method.cost: USD from each request's measured usage at the runner's pricing; $/hr = 450 x mean per transmission
